correctness.rationale: The exact t-step support identity S(F^t x)=S(x)+{-t,-t+2,...,t} follows by Boolean distributivity. The +2 orbit decomposition and maximum-gap covering lemma give the least entry time into the periodic set. Monotone two-step support expansion implies all periodic states are unions of full +2 orbits, yielding two odd-ring fixed points and, in even rings, two fixed points and one two-cycle. Rooted cyclic compositions prove the polynomial by a q/k multiplicity bijection. Inclusion-exclusion yields explicit binomial coefficients and the two sharp extremizer counts. The provided checker independently exhausts 131,064 configurations of rings 3–16 and 4,800 deterministic larger samples, comparing actual preperiods and every fixed-weight cumulative coefficient. Finite tests corroborate; the argument applies to every n >= 3.

value.rationale: Exact preperiod-by-Hamming-weight counts for every n and time resolve the whole transient-depth distribution of the natural OR-additive elementary cellular automaton, rather than an arbitrary small parameter slice. The q=n versus q=n/2 orbit split reveals an exact parity bifurcation in the attractor and relaxation structures; the sharp maximal-delay and labelled-extremizer formulas quantify rare worst-case initial conditions. These invariants are motivated by finite-state convergence, provide direct benchmarks for Boolean network and CA dynamics, and are not merely a rewritten local update rule. The classical cyclic-composition step is explicitly acknowledged.
